title: Contracted Professional Payment Queries
description: Draft public-service guidance; review questions must be resolved before publication.
clarifying_questions: Does the issue concern nonpayment, underpayment or overpayment?
Which examination, year, series and contracted position does it concern?

claims.text: The historical manual includes nonpayment, underpayment and overpayment queries for contracted professionals.

The September 2017 QMIS guide shows a Contracted Professionals form requiring examination, year, series, position worked, nature of query, amount expected, amount received, institution worked at and a description before submission.

citations.locator: PDF pp7-8, sections 3.3.1-3.3.4 and Contracted Professionals screen

claims.text: The example screen shows the Required List controlling attachments and illustrates a declaration form and attendance register; these examples are not a verified universal current checklist.

The 2026 charter requires contracted examination personnel to meet selection criteria, comply with contract terms including payments, and provide accurate, adequate, factual and timely supporting information; it does not state a payment-query resolution time.

The historical form asks for identity and payment-related facts inside QMIS. Users must enter such information only in the official portal and must not send identity numbers, payment credentials or personal records to the WhatsApp assistant.

unresolved_questions: Confirm current contracted-personnel categories, Required List documents and live QMIS fields.
Confirm investigation ownership, processing period and escalation route.
Do not infer entitlement or payment amount from a user's description.
